تبتذلون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَذِلُونَ (tabtaḏilūna) /tab.ta.ði.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# تُبْتَذَلُونَ (tubtaḏalūna) /tub.ta.ða.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
